reviews.review_title: 💰Protect Your Gold Fun MR Tower Defense
reviews.review_description:
Treasure Defend is a fun mixed reality (MR) game that puts you in charge of protecting your precious treasure from waves of greedy bandits. Armed with a single weapon and the ability to strategically place towers around your environment, your mission is simple: don't let the thieves get away with your gold!

Bandits emerge from multiple portals, moving at different speeds and coming in various sizes. Some will take a bigger share of your treasure than others, so you need to react quickly and prioritise your targets. Don't worry, though! If a thief manages to grab some gold, you can still take them down and recover your loot!

One thing I particularly appreciate is the shooting mechanics. The aiming precision is excellent and very intuitive. Even without a laser pointer, you quickly get a feel for where your shots will land, making it easy and satisfying to hit bandits from a distance.

The combination of wave survival, tower placement, and quick shooting makes for an enjoyable and accessible MR experience. Your real environment becomes part of the battlefield, adding another layer of fun to defending your treasure.

It's great to see mixed reality games making a comeback and developers getting creative with new ways to use our surroundings. Treasure Defend is a good example of how a simple concept, when properly executed, can deliver plenty of entertainment.

Survive the waves, protect your gold, and don't let those bandits get away! A fun little MR experience worth checking out. Recommended!

developer_response.body: Thank you for testing the game and for your feedback, I'm really happy that you enjoyed it.
